designationHistory.indexText: The National Park Service and the Bureau of Reclamation signed a memorandum of agreement placing the Curecanti reservoir lands under National Park Service management as a national recreation area.

authority.citation: Memorandum of Agreement between the National Park Service and the Bureau of Reclamation, Feb. 11, 1965

designationHistory.note: The agreement itself was not found online. The day (Feb. 11) comes from NPS; the Senate report gives the year. Congress has not passed a law establishing the area; boundary bills (for example the CORE Act) were still pending.

sources.name: NPS, Curecanti Laws & Policies (Memorandum of Agreement)
